requirements.display_name: Replacement automotive fuse of the specified amperage

actions.title: Switch the vehicle and electrical equipment off
actions.instruction: Switch the engine switch off and turn off the electrical component associated with the suspected fuse.

actions.title: Locate the correct fuse box and circuit
actions.instruction: Use the fuse-box cover diagrams and the owner manual to identify the fuse for the affected circuit.

actions.title: Remove the accessible Type A or Type B fuse
actions.instruction: Use the fuse puller to remove the suspected Type A or Type B fuse and inspect the element.
actions.warning_text: Type C cartridge-style fuse replacement is not included in this guided workflow; Toyota directs that service to a dealer.

actions.title: Install a fuse of the specified amperage
actions.instruction: If the fuse is blown, install a replacement of the same specified amperage rating.
actions.warning_text: Never install a fuse with a higher amperage rating or substitute another material for a fuse.

actions.title: Verify operation and stop if the fuse blows again
actions.instruction: Switch the vehicle as needed and verify the circuit operates. If the replacement fuse blows again, stop and have the electrical system inspected.
